calendar_export_boundary_note: If an event reminder can also be exported to a device calendar, that export is treated as a separate reminder handoff surface rather than seamless continuity of the platform relationship state.
current_help_recovery_note: When follow, subscribe, or reminder surfaces could mislead, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of pretending the platform relationship alone is controlling.
delivery_limitations_note: Platform-managed notification delivery is treated as variable, ranked, delayed, or unsupported in some contexts rather than as a guaranteed complete notice lane.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews platform-native follow, subscribe, and event-reminder surfaces so channel relationships and reminder registrations remain subordinate to the current official page/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow standing notice service for still-current voter instructions.
feed_and_inbox_adjacency_note: Subscriptions feeds, reminder inboxes, and followed-channel views are reviewed for recommendation and mixed-content adjacency so one official channel does not cause neighboring content to inherit the same authority.
follow_reminder_provenance_note: The service distinguishes official channel ownership from the viewer's platform-managed follow, subscribe, or reminder state.
follow_reminder_surface_label: Example follow, subscription, and event-reminder posture for official voter-information media routes

reviewed_follow_reminder_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official channel can be followed or subscribed to and whether that relationship is described honestly as optional, platform-managed, and incomplete by itself.
Reviewed whether delivery is personalized, all-available, or otherwise limited by platform behavior rather than treated as a guaranteed office-controlled lane.
Reviewed whether a premiere or livestream reminder can be registered and whether the reminder stays subordinate to the current written route before the voter acts.
Reviewed whether subscriptions feeds, notification inboxes, or followed-channel views can mix recommendations, unrelated channels, or older media beside the official item.
